title: The Silent Choir
scene: At 6:25 PM, the choir songbook vanished. The practice room was locked from 6:00 to 6:45.

suspects.name: Vera Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the hall at 6:25, setting chairs.
suspects.alibiProof: The hall camera shows Vera at 6:23.

suspects.name: Walter Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the cafe at 6:25.
suspects.alibiProof: The cafe receipt for Walter is stamped 6:24.

suspects.name: Xiomara Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the practice room at 6:25, playing the score.
suspects.contradiction: The practice room was locked from outside, and page corners were in Xiomara's bag.

suspects.name: Yosef Lund
suspects.testimony: I was mopping the corridor at 6:25.
suspects.alibiProof: The corridor camera shows Yosef at 6:22 and 6:31.
